#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class CF1187G {
public:
    CF1187G() : sc(nullptr) {}
    
    class FastScanner {
    private:
        istream& in;
        vector<char> buffer;
        int ptr, len;
        
    public:
        FastScanner(istream& stream) : in(stream), buffer(1 << 15), ptr(0), len(0) {}
        
        int read() {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                ptr = 0;
                len = in.readsome(&buffer[0], buffer.size());
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }
        
        int nextInt() {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= 32) if (c == -1) return -1;
            int val = 0;
            do {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
            } while ((c = read()) > 32);
            return val;
        }
    };
    
    FastScanner* sc;
    
    static const int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<vector<int>> graph;
    int nNodes, nEdges;
    vector<int> potential, dist, prevEdge;
    vector<int> from, to, xorMask, edgeCost;
    vector<int> capacity;
    
    void initialize(int nodes, int edges) {
        graph.resize(nodes);
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) graph[i].clear();
        potential.assign(nodes, 0);
        dist.assign(nodes, 0);
        prevEdge.assign(nodes, 0);
        from.assign(edges, 0);
        to.assign(edges, 0);
        xorMask.assign(edges, 0);
        edgeCost.assign(edges, 0);
        capacity.assign(edges * 2, 0);
        nEdges = 0;
    }
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        int idx = nEdges++;
        from[idx] = u;
        to[idx] = v;
        xorMask[idx] = u ^ v;
        edgeCost[idx] = cost;
        capacity[idx * 2] = cap;
        graph[u].push_back(idx * 2);
        graph[v].push_back(idx * 2 + 1);
    }
    
    vector<int> queue;
    int queueHead, queueTail, queueSize;
    vector<bool> inQueue;
    
    void addToQueue(int node) {
        if (inQueue[node]) return;
        if (queueHead + queueTail == (int)queue.size()) {
            if (queueSize * 2 <= (int)queue.size()) {
                vector<int> temp(queueSize);
                copy(queue.begin() + queueHead, queue.begin() + queueHead + queueSize, temp.begin());
                queue = temp;
            } else {
                vector<int> newQueue(queue.size() * 2);
                copy(queue.begin() + queueHead, queue.begin() + queueHead + queueSize, newQueue.begin());
                queue = newQueue;
            }
            queueHead = 0;
        }
        queue[queueHead + queueTail++] = node;
        inQueue[node] = true;
    }
    
    int removeFromQueue() {
        int node = queue[queueHead++];
        queueSize--;
        inQueue[node] = false;
        return node;
    }
    
    bool spfa(int source, int sink) {
        fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), INF);
        potential[source] = 0;
        queueHead = queueTail = 0;
        addToQueue(source);
        
        while (queueSize > 0) {
            int u = removeFromQueue();
            int newDist = dist[u] + 1;
            
            for (int edgeIndex : graph[u]) {
                if (capacity[edgeIndex] > 0) {
                    int edgeId = edgeIndex >> 1;
                    int cost = (edgeIndex & 1) == 0 ? edgeCost[edgeId] : -edgeCost[edgeId];
                    int newPotential = potential[u] + cost;
                    int v = u ^ xorMask[edgeId];
                    
                    if (potential[v] > newPotential || 
                        (potential[v] == newPotential && dist[v] > newDist)) {
                        potential[v] = newPotential;
                        dist[v] = newDist;
                        prevEdge[v] = edgeIndex;
                        addToQueue(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return potential[sink] != INF;
    }
    
    void augmentPath(int source, int sink) {
        int minCapacity = INF;
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v ^= xorMask[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            minCapacity = min(minCapacity, capacity[prevEdge[v]]);
        }
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v ^= xorMask[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            int idx = prevEdge[v];
            capacity[idx] -= minCapacity;
            capacity[idx ^ 1] += minCapacity;
        }
    }
    
    void augmentPathUnit(int source, int sink) {
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v ^= xorMask[prevEdge[v] >> 1]) {
            int idx = prevEdge[v];
            capacity[idx]--;
            capacity[idx ^ 1]++;
        }
    }
    
    int minCostMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        while (spfa(source, sink)) {
            augmentPathUnit(source, sink);
        }
        int totalCost = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < nEdges; i++) {
            totalCost += edgeCost[i] * capacity[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        return totalCost;
    }
    
    void run() {
        sc = new FastScanner(cin);
        int n = sc->nextInt();
        int m = sc->nextInt();
        int k = sc->nextInt();
        int c = sc->nextInt();
        int d = sc->nextInt();
        
        vector<int> specialNodes(k);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            specialNodes[i] = sc->nextInt() - 1;
        }
        
        vector<vector<int>> adj(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj[i].clear();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc->nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc->nextInt() - 1;
            adj[u].push_back(v);
            adj[v].push_back(u);
        }
        
        int timeHorizon = k + 1;
        int totalNodes = n * timeHorizon + 1;
        int totalEdges = k + (m * 2 * k + n) * (timeHorizon - 1);
        
        initialize(totalNodes, totalEdges);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < timeHorizon - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * timeHorizon + t;
                for (int neighbor : adj[i]) {
                    int v = neighbor * timeHorizon + t + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        addEdge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < timeHorizon - 1; t++) {
                int u = i * timeHorizon + t;
                int v = u + 1;
                addEdge(u, v, k, i == 0 ? 0 : c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            addEdge(totalNodes - 1, specialNodes[i] * timeHorizon, 1, 0);
        }
        
        cout << minCostMaxFlow(totalNodes - 1, 0 * timeHorizon + timeHorizon - 1) << endl;
        
        delete sc;
    }
};

int main() {
    CF1187G solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
